_comment: exp/nextgen-fin +-45-SKIN architecture, sweep 2, WITH BIAX. s1: hexcel_himax_biax_100 @ 45 skins over 1 UD core pair (through 1.07 mm) gave flex 11.6 N MID, k_twist 16088 at theta_at_probe 121.8 deg -- twist ~equal to the 16249 baseline (the thin +-45 shell adds little), flex ~4 N under target. s2 walks flex up to ~13.5 with a slightly heavier core / MID pad and adds a second +-45 skin ply option to lift k_twist above the baseline.
_targets: flex W(90) ~13.5 N (baseline 15.52 - 2), kick MID f~0.46, k_twist > 16249 N.mm/rad at theta_at_probe ~118 deg (matched).
